identity.title: Integrate approval and budget violations into governed outcome without creating a new state machine

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Extend the existing 8029 governed-outcome rule set only enough to prevent false CLEAN_SUCCESS when explicit approval or budget governance evidence is unresolved/violated. Reuse existing signals and ordered deterministic precedence. Dependency: 8035.project-budget-evidence.
human_pressure.why_now: Once approval/budget are visible, Ailuros must not show CLEAN_SUCCESS while explicit governance violations are present. The fix belongs in the existing derived outcome, not a second control engine.
do_not_misread: This repository is the canonical Ailuros governance runtime; do not apply cleanup assumptions from the legacy MCP Gateway repository.
Identity references are governance provenance, not login/authentication/session management.
Approval and budget in this batch are evidence-backed records/projections, not workflow/payment services.
Do not turn Ailuros into an agent executor or coding harness.

machine_core.goal: Fold new evidence-backed approval/budget signals into the existing governed outcome deterministically.
invariants: Depends on: 8035.project-budget-evidence. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
contracts: Approval/budget facts influence governed outcome only when explicit evidence makes them relevant.
failure_semantics: Missing governance-context evidence remains unknown/absent; it is never inferred as allowed, approved, within budget or clean.
Explicit denial/violation evidence is preserved with evidence refs.
Derived control-context state remains rebuildable from immutable evidence.
Producer-native values remain preserved alongside normalized projections.

steps.title: Extend existing precedence only
details: Explicit budget_exceeded or approval-denied-with-observed-protected-action is a blocking governance violation and cannot yield clean/degraded success.
Explicit unresolved required approval yields REVIEW_REQUIRED when no stronger failure applies.
Required budget evaluation with unresolved/unknown result cannot yield CLEAN_SUCCESS.

steps.title: Reuse existing outcome vocabulary
details: Keep CLEAN_SUCCESS, DEGRADED_SUCCESS, REVIEW_REQUIRED, FAILED, UNKNOWN from 8029.
Do not add a second governance state machine, score or new terminal enum.

steps.title: Expose reason/evidence refs
details: Run report includes stable reason codes and evidence refs for approval/budget-driven outcomes.

steps.title: Regression matrix
details: Native success + unresolved required approval => REVIEW_REQUIRED, not CLEAN_SUCCESS.
Native success + explicit budget exceeded => FAILED, not CLEAN/DEGRADED.
No approval/budget evidence => existing 8029 behavior unchanged.
Unknown budget context cannot be silently treated as clean when evidence says budget evaluation was required.

acceptance: Existing governed outcome vocabulary and precedence model remain intact.
Explicit approval/budget governance problems cannot produce CLEAN_SUCCESS.
Producers without approval/budget evidence preserve previous behavior.
Report reasons are deterministic and evidence-linked.
No live control service/state machine is introduced.
validate: python -m pytest tests/test_governed_outcome.py tests/test_approval_governance.py tests/test_budget_governance.py tests/test_execution_report.py -q
python -m ruff check src/ailuros/projection.py src/ailuros/signals.py src/ailuros/execution_report.py tests/test_governed_outcome.py tests/test_approval_governance.py tests/test_budget_governance.py

must_check: The existing outcome model is extended rather than replaced.
reject_if: A composite risk score or LLM judge is added.
A new outcome/state-machine framework is introduced.
Absence of approval/budget evidence globally forces failure for producers that never declared such governance requirements.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed/approved/within-budget.
